table.context: Given in section 74, Local Finance, to compare the 1920 provincial Local Expenses Budget with 1919 and 1910, the text noting it grew to about 14,000,000 yen, roughly eleven times 1910 and double 1919.
transcriber_notes: Rows: 3 per part (1920, 1919, 1910), 4 parts, as printed.
Dotted leaders after year labels omitted; '—' dashes kept as printed.

Totals: Revenue 1920 and 1919 sums reconcile; Revenue 1910 parts sum to 1,000,716 but total printed 1,000,715 (kept as printed, digit re-checked at enlargement). Grand Total 1920/1919/1910 reconcile; Expenditure totals 1920/1919/1910 reconcile.
Read from crops of full/p0222.jpg (4 tight strips, plus enlarged crop of the 1910 row). No unreadable cells.
Verified: an independent blind second transcription agreed on every other cell; the totals that do not reconcile are as printed.
